title: observability-control-plane.v2
description: The evaluator and router this repository owns for one environment. Identity and topology only: no product decisions, no secret values.  v2 applies ADR-0004: `host` carries a logical `target_id` and nothing else. The resolved identity and SSH alias moved to the private inventory, where they still serve both purposes they were added for — a receipt recording which host was changed, and an operator comparing the named target with the declared one.

target_id.description: The LOGICAL host this control plane runs on. Its resolved identity and SSH alias live in the private inventory under the same target_id (ADR-0004). Naming a host logically here is not an instruction to connect anywhere: AGENTS.md rule 17 requires a human to name the target in the authorizing request, and this value is what that name is checked against.

release_root.description: Absolute directory holding immutable release directories. Bind mounts point at a symlink under this root, never at a single file: a single-file bind mount detaches its inode on rename and is why in-place host editing became the only workable path.

external_labels.description: Labels stamped on every series this evaluator owns. An ordered array, not an object, so rendering is deterministic without sorting a mapping.

secrets_dir.description: HOST directory holding secret FILES, mounted read-only into both evaluators. A directory mount, not a file mount. Distinct from the in-container paths, which the renderer fixes at /etc/prometheus/secrets and /etc/alertmanager/secrets so a config reference and its mount cannot disagree — do not spell this value as one of those, or the next operator creates the directory in the wrong filesystem. This repository names files here; it never holds their contents.

smtp.description: Global SMTP settings. Required whenever any receiver declares an email integration: Alertmanager refuses a config whose email receiver has no smarthost, and the refusal surfaces as a control plane that will not start.

image.description: Image reference WITHOUT a tag-only identity; the digest below is the identity.

version.description: Human-readable version recorded in receipts. Evidence, never the pin.

listen.description: host:port the service binds. PUBLIC ONLY WHILE THE ADDRESS IS A LOOPBACK ADDRESS, which settles the second classification ADR-0004 left open and is enforced by the LISTEN-NOT-LOOPBACK gate rather than left as a habit. A loopback bind describes this control plane's own posture and is the evidence docs/SECURITY.md cites that the rendered stack keeps its ports off every non-loopback interface; any other address is a resolved bind address, which is private material, and belongs in the private inventory instead.
